phase1_assignment.objective: Test multi-run planning, checkpoint reconstruction, forecast-overrun detection, alternative-plan switching and stale or duplicate continuation defenses for scheduled Chat agents under the current sanitized zero-Work-dependency, zero-finite-quota, zero-incremental-cost Phase-1 root.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; direct probe before decomposition; compare a valid continuation trace with stale, duplicated and forecast-overrun traces. Per invocation use checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slicing and persist exact switching criteria/continuation. While the temporary lifecycle-persistence fast path below is active, perform only its no-semantic receipt proof and preserve the substantive frontier as fallback metadata.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A tested mechanism or exact blocker, tested scope, durable checkpoint and exact next Phase-1 action.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Select the next non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf; do not resume unrelated base work during Phase 1.

non_regression.rule: Preserve config8/config7 substantive long-horizon role, CLEAN boundary, tested-scope/provenance, continuation/recovery, forecast-overrun and alternative-plan semantics, repository write boundary, primary boundary and base restoration metadata. Config9 changes only the temporary Phase-1 lifecycle-persistence bootstrap after a causally current post-fix scheduled invocation remained physically enabled but left no new role-local checkpoint or immutable receipt. It removes optional semantic/state reconstruction from the proof path and requires only current manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE and this exact role config before one immutable receipt/readback.

policy.own_state_resolution: For substantive work use role-local LATEST or STATE first, otherwise the newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint. Config9's temporary lifecycle-only fast path is the sole exception: it may copy the optimizer-validated immutable LATEST tuple recorded below only into a no-semantic lifecycle receipt and may not treat it as authority for a new scientific conclusion, credit increment, frontier advancement or state/LATEST mutation. Before later substantive semantic work, normal own_state_resolution applies again.
policy.scope_guard: Keep every claim within its tested scope.
policy.continuation: One result or blocker is not global completion; preserve a nonempty Phase-1 frontier and exact next action. Outside the temporary lifecycle-only fast path, execute one checkpoint-first single-effect-chain micro-slice per invocation and return recurring-open after durable checkpoint/readback when frontier remains.

control_freshness.substantive_semantic_work: Use a SHA-only main-ref bootstrap when available. When unavailable, read the approved sanitized root and this role config twice before semantic work, require identical returned blob SHAs and parsed revisions, then freeze that tuple as transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.config9_lifecycle_only_exception: Perform no substantive semantic work. Directly read current INSTRUCTION_CONTROL_MANIFEST, current RUN_LIFECYCLE and this current role config once; require the fetched role-config blob and RUN_LIFECYCLE blob to equal the current_blob values declared by the fetched manifest. Require the manifest to declare a nonempty current DESIRED_STATE blob/revision identity, but do not fetch the DESIRED_STATE body, perform a main-ref lookup, second authority pass, public-source read or role-local semantic-state read. Any mismatch/missing entry uses only the prompt emergency fallback and earns no persistence credit.
control_freshness.failure: Write at most the compact authorized role-local diagnostic when possible, retain recurring enablement and retry only on the next invocation; never wait, poll, back off or retry in-run.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop when frozen authority blobs remain unchanged.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.purpose: Preserve multi-run long-horizon progress and prove bounded recurring survival after the role was physically re-enabled while enabled_desired remained true.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.evidence_basis: The optimizer re-enabled the same long_horizon task at 2026-09-02T10:01:37.827882+09:00. Live inventory later observed a post-fix scheduled run at 2026-09-02T10:25:26.921834+09:00 and the task still enabled, but exact directory inspection found no 2026-09-02 immutable receipt and no 2026-09-02 role-local checkpoint; the newest visible role-local diagnostic remained 2026-08-29T23:25:33+09:00. Thus config8 did not leave the role-valid bounded durable continuation required for scheduler-persistence credit on the first causally current post-fix run.

single_effect_chain.definition: The smallest safe substantive planning/verification unit whose evidence and continuation are complete only after mandatory persistence/readback; never split an integrity-atomic sequence.
single_effect_chain.after_chain: Persist/read back the role-local checkpoint/output and immutable own receipt with exact continuation before any optional follow-on work. Do not start another optional chain in the same invocation.

scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_receipt_priority: A role-valid immutable terminal receipt plus exact nonempty continuation and readback outranks optional semantic work once the allowed bounded slice is complete. A scheduled run without such a receipt earns no persistence credit and remains an unresolved lifecycle blocker.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.continuation_contract: If frontier remains, return recurring-open with exact next effect_chain_id or exact predecessor/frontier identity so the next recurrence does not duplicate completed effects.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.terminal_marker_semantics: A terminal response marker such as ::SKIP_COMPLETION:: is only a lifecycle/scheduling marker and is never role/root completion evidence.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_missing_capability: Persist exact blocker and preserve an alternative-route child when the already-authorized own write surface is available; unavailable capability is unresolved, never solved.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.on_tool_or_rate_limit_risk: Checkpoint current chain/continuation before optional work when possible; do not wait, poll, back off or retry within the same invocation.
scheduled_chat_lifecycle_survival_contra.rollback_condition: If config9 weakens CLEAN, scope/provenance, base restoration or exact continuation, increment config and repair immediately. If the three-read authority proof plus one receipt write/readback still cannot leave a readback-valid receipt within RUN_LIFECYCLE, keep the role enabled and classify the exact transport/platform termination cause as the unresolved child; never disable the role or reintroduce run-until-hard-stop semantics.

policy.scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired is true, an invocation boundary, no-result run, missing ref lookup or blocker does not change the recurring enabled state.
policy.primary_boundary: Do not alter primary O authority or protected execution state; do not merge directly to main.
